title: S01T03 - Complete licensing, provenance, dependency, secret, and public-history audit
description: Prepare an owner-reviewed open-source boundary, validate prior-art and dependency provenance, scan secrets and machine paths, and identify tracker, memory, dump, or history content that must not ship.
acceptanceCriteria: The owner selects and applies the public license, with Apache-2.0 as the recommended default unless an explicit alternative is approved.
Automated secret and dependency-license scans pass, and every excluded or sanitized path is documented with its reason.
The prior-art audit and AI-assisted authorship/provenance caveats receive an explicit legal-review handoff.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
